full_judgment: 2. It appears from the materials on record that the respondents earlier filed A.T. Case No. 221 of 2019 before the Administrative Tribunal No. 1 Dhaka. On 18.11.2019 they filed an application for non-prosecution of the said A.T. Case No. 221 of 2019 which was allowed. The Administrative Tribunal dismissed the A.T. Case No. 221 of 2019 for non-prosecution on the same date. Thereafter, the respondents filed Writ Petition No. 3142 of 2020 in the High Court Division. At the time of motion hearing the learned Advocate of the writ petitioners submits that owing to the decision of Bangladesh and others Vs. Sontosh Kumar Saha and others reported in 21 BLC(AD)94 they do not want to proceed with the writ petition. The High Court Division dismissed the writ petition as being not pressed as prayed for However, the High Court Division while dismissing the writ petition as being not pressed, observed that the Administrative Tribunal shall entertain their petition, if any, by condoning delay under section 14 of the Limitation Act by its impugned judgment and order dated 08.03.2020 in Writ Petition No. 3142 of 2020. Against which, the petitioners have preferred this civil petition for leave to appeal.
